selectionNote: Each outlet or account below was checked against its own public site or a public RSS response on 9 November 2026. LiveUAMap was not scraped and is not a source. X accounts are listed for a later updater; this app does not call the X API.

sources.why: Public BBC Middle East RSS. The feed responded with current articles during this check. A BBC article is a sourced report, not confirmation by itself.
sources.claimPolicy: Sourced claim until a separate independent source reports the same thing. Still not a verified event.

sources.why: Public BBC Europe RSS, used for the Ukraine theater. Items must mention Ukraine or a Ukrainian place before they appear.
sources.claimPolicy: Sourced claim until a separate independent source reports the same thing. Still not a verified event.

sources.why: Public English RSS from Al Jazeera. The homepage links the @AJEnglish account separately. Theater keywords keep unrelated world news out of each map.
sources.claimPolicy: Sourced claim until a separate independent source reports the same thing. Still not a verified event.

sources.why: Public Guardian world RSS. Included as an English-language newsroom with a published corrections process. No X handle is listed because this check did not see one on the page.
sources.claimPolicy: Sourced claim until a separate independent source reports the same thing. Still not a verified event.

sources.why: Ukraine's national news agency publishes this English RSS. Its site also links @ukrinform_news. Agency copy is still a claim, especially when it relays official statements.
sources.claimPolicy: Sourced claim. National-agency copy is not treated as independent confirmation of a battlefield event.

sources.why: English-language Ukrainian newsroom. The public RSS address was linked from kyivindependent.com on 9 November 2026. The older /feed/ path returned 404.
sources.claimPolicy: Sourced claim until a separate independent source reports the same thing. Still not a verified event.

sources.why: Public UN News regional RSS for multilateral statements and humanitarian updates. UN News links @UN_News_Centre from news.un.org.
sources.claimPolicy: Official or multilateral statement. Not an independently verified event.

sources.why: Public UN News Europe RSS. Ukraine items are kept only when the text names Ukraine or a Ukrainian place.
sources.claimPolicy: Official or multilateral statement. Not an independently verified event.

sources.why: Official English RSS of the Ukrainian presidency, already used by WarMap's collector. This environment received HTTP 403 from the feed, so it may be missing until the origin allows the request. No X handle was visible on the page during this check.
sources.claimPolicy: Official statement from a party to the conflict. A presidential post or release is a claim, not confirmation.

sources.why: bbc.com/news links twitter.com/bbc. Posts are not fetched live. An updater may copy public posts into the snapshot file with the original status URL.
sources.claimPolicy: A single post is a sourced claim, never a verified event.

sources.why: aljazeera.com links twitter.com/ajenglish. Included as the outlet's public X account, not as a LiveUAMap endorsement. Not polled live.
sources.claimPolicy: A single post is a sourced claim, never a verified event.

sources.why: ukrinform.net links twitter.com/ukrinform_news. Snapshot only.
sources.claimPolicy: National-agency post. Not independent confirmation.

sources.why: kyivindependent.com links twitter.com/kyivindependent. Snapshot only.
sources.claimPolicy: A single post is a sourced claim, never a verified event.

sources.why: news.un.org links twitter.com/UN_News_Centre. Snapshot only. Multilateral posts stay labeled as statements.
sources.claimPolicy: Multilateral statement. Not an independently verified event.

sources.displayName: Ministry of Defence of Ukraine on X
sources.why: mod.gov.ua links x.com/DefenceU. This is a conflict-party official account. Its posts are claims and need a higher bar than a newsroom report. Not polled live.
sources.claimPolicy: Official claim from a party to the conflict. Never auto-verified.

sources.why: ukmto.org/contact-us says UKMTO publishes maritime safety information on its website and on X. The public status https://x.com/UK_MTO/status/2119830956169175405 is the organization's post for warning 199-26. This server does not call the X API. An updater copies the post into the snapshot.
sources.claimPolicy: Official maritime warning. A single UKMTO post is a sourced report, not an independently verified event.

sources.why: Public warning PDFs and the JMIC advisory on ukmto.org. Used when the wording comes from the document rather than from a copied X post. Not a live crawl of the site.
sources.claimPolicy: Official maritime warning. Not an independently verified event.

sources.why: Public X account of U.S. Central Command. Included as an official military source for the same theaters as UKMTO. Not polled live. Conflict-party or intervening-military posts stay claims.
sources.claimPolicy: Official military statement. Never auto-verified.

sources.displayName: UK Ministry of Defence on X
sources.why: Public X account of the UK Ministry of Defence, the department UKMTO belongs to. Snapshot only. Official posts are claims.
sources.claimPolicy: Official statement. Never auto-verified.

sources.why: Public X account of the Israel Defense Forces. Snapshot only. A conflict-party account cannot confirm its own claim.
sources.claimPolicy: Official claim from a party to the conflict. Never auto-verified.
